$schema_note: Baseline imutável do bitstream de produção do Kapuã QRNG. Gerado em 2026-08-29 por inspeção SOMENTE LEITURA via multi-hop SSH (local -> Bongo -> dobslit -> FPGA 10.0.10.2). Nenhuma escrita, nenhuma reprogramação, nenhum acesso destrutivo a MMIO.
collection_method: read-only SSH (paramiko nested channels); sha256sum/sha512sum/stat/od/python3 on-board; no /dev/mem access; no fpgautil; no JTAG

board.on_board_uname: Linux rp-f0d1e2 5.15.0-xilinx #1 SMP PREEMPT Tue Aug 6 18:57:28 UTC 2024 armv7l
board.clock_state: SEM NTP / RTC dessincronizado: o relógio da placa marcava 2026-03-28 durante a coleta (data real 2026-08-29). TODOS os timestamps abaixo estão nesse relógio enviesado.
board.device_discrepancy: IDCODE do bitstream = 0x03722093 = xc7z010 (Zynq-7010). 'monitor -f' = z10_125. A documentacao do projeto diz z20_125_4ch / Zynq-7020. Discrepancia NAO resolvida nesta etapa: precisa de confirmacao dos autores. Ver FPGA_PROVENANCE.md.

primary_bitstream.name: stream_app.bit.bin
primary_bitstream.file_type: raw Xilinx 7-series configuration bitstream, headerless (.bin), 32-bit words byte-swapped vs canonical .bit (Red Pitaya / fpgautil PCAP convention). 'file' command not installed on board; type determined by parsing the config packet stream.
primary_bitstream.sync_word: 0xAA995566 present at byte offset 48 after de-swapping (dummy pad 0xFF x8, bus-width detect 0x000000BB / 0x11220044, more 0xFF, then sync)
primary_bitstream.embedded_build_metadata: NONE. No .bit ASCII header => no design name, no Vivado version string, no build date, no user id. 'strings' output is pure configuration-frame data.

config_registers_parsed.CTL0: 0x00000501  => ENC bit (bit 6) = 0  => bitstream NOT encrypted; no AES/HMAC

primary_bitstream.compressed: Vivado BITSTREAM.GENERAL.COMPRESS status NOT determined from header alone. Note: stock Red Pitaya .bit.bin sizes on this same board range 372 KB..2.4 MB for the same device => compression IS used in the RP flow; file size is NOT a reliable device/design discriminator.

associated_files_on_board.dtbo_dts: none co-located; the runtime DT overlay is a STOCK Red Pitaya dtbo, see loader section
associated_files_on_board.BOOT_BIN: none co-located (a stock /boot/boot.bin exists, unrelated to this fabric load)

sibling_bitstream.relation_to_primary: SAME size (2083744). Differs in 63379 of ~2.08M bytes, in a single contiguous region of the FDRI frame data (bytes 249301..2081652). Same device, same I/O ring, same base infrastructure => interpreted as the SAME Vivado project built with a different top-level/mode (a DAC test-pattern build vs the streaming build). Circumstantial, not proven without sources.

loader.exec_start_pre: /opt/redpitaya/bin/fpgautil -b /root/stream_app.bit.bin   (NO -o overlay argument => reprograms PL fabric only, leaves the device-tree overlay untouched)
loader.load_evidence_journal: Mar 28 06:46:52 rp-f0d1e2 fpgautil[378]: Time taken to load BIN is 39.000000 Milli Seconds  ;  systemd: Started QRNG FPGA stream TCP server ; bash[401]: ISR 0x0 = 900000 -> ISR 0x0 = ffffffff
loader.boot_fabric_before_override: startup.sh -> mkoverlay.sh v0.94 -> overlay.sh: fpgautil -b /opt/redpitaya/fpga/<model>/v0.94/fpga.bit.bin -o .../v0.94/fpga.dtbo -n Full  (/tmp/loaded_fpga.inf = 'v0.94')

device_tree_overlay.source_dtbo: a STOCK Red Pitaya fpga.dtbo (from the 'v0.94' variant selected by startup.sh at boot). NOT regenerated when qrng-stream reprogrammed the fabric with /root/stream_app.bit.bin.
device_tree_overlay.impact_on_datapath: NONE. fifo.c reaches the AXI4-Stream FIFO by mmap of /dev/mem at physical 0x43C00000 (raw), NOT through a UIO/DT node. The stock overlay describes rp_oscilloscope@0x40000000 and rp_gpio@0x40200000 only; it does NOT describe anything at 0x43C00000. The custom FIFO block is therefore invisible to the device tree by design.

datapath_contract_fifo_c.RDFD_offset_read: 0x11000 (Receive Data FIFO Data -- read POPS one 32-bit word)
datapath_contract_fifo_c.conditioning_in_software: NONE. No XOR, no hash, no decimation, no bit-selection, no framing. Verbatim: read RDFD -> htole32 -> write 4 bytes.
datapath_contract_fifo_c.transport_word: uint32, little-endian, 4 bytes == exactly one RDFD read
